children: The International Atomic Energy Agency said on October 2 that Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant is considering further reducing the number of emergency diesel generators kept in automatic standby because diesel reserves remain low. According to Sina Finance, the agency said the plant relied on emergency diesel generators for nearly three weeks in August and September after losing external power for an extended period, which significantly reduced diesel stocks.

The agency said recent efforts to replenish diesel have still been hindered by military activity in the surrounding area. It also said the plant has lost external power 10 times since June and is now dependent on a single 330-kilovolt external transmission line.

International Atomic Energy Agency Director General Rafael Grossi said the continued lack of diesel deliveries is worsening the already fragile nuclear safety situation at Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant and called on the relevant parties to ensure fuel reaches the plant as soon as possible.

title: Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Plant May Cut Number of Standby Emergency Generators
